title: GR-like Projection Domain Registry
purpose: Define the governed feature space for GR-like projection analogs including continuation, smoothness, propagation, geometry-like persistence, constraint flow, and large-scale coherence without claiming derivation of general relativity.

domain_definition.canonical_statement: GR-like projection domains are projection-derived analog structures emphasizing continuation, smoothness, propagation, geometry-like persistence, and bounded constraint flow.
domain_definition.non_identity_rule: GR-like projection domains are not general relativity and may not be promoted to physical interpretation.

governed_feature_classes.name: continuation_flow
governed_feature_classes.definition: Projection emphasis on persistence and continuation across locally constrained domains.

governed_feature_classes.name: smoothness_readability
governed_feature_classes.definition: Projection readability favoring continuous-looking structure per distinction detail abstraction.

governed_feature_classes.name: geometry_like_persistence
governed_feature_classes.definition: Projection-stabilized persistence structure resembling geometry-like coherence.

governed_feature_classes.name: constraint_flow_channeling
governed_feature_classes.definition: Projection emphasis on bounded redistribution of admissibility constraints.

governed_feature_classes.name: local_coherence_surface
governed_feature_classes.definition: Projection surface over which continuation appears locally coherent.

governed_feature_classes.name: propagation_readability
governed_feature_classes.definition: Projection emphasis on continuation appearing as transport or propagation under local constraints.

allowed_uses: Analyzing geometry-like persistence as projection-induced structure.
Modeling bounded constraint flow under local admissibility governance.
Comparing smoothness-heavy projection structure against QM-like distinction-heavy domains.
forbidden_uses: Claiming derivation of spacetime curvature, Einstein field equations, or physical gravitation.
Treating constraint flow as physical gravitational field dynamics.
Promoting geometry-like persistence into spacetime ontology.
forbidden: Using GR-like projections as forbidden: proof of reality.

governance_rules.rule: GR-like projection structures remain subordinate to ⇔R source relations.
GR-like structures must declare projection depth and recoverability class.
GR-like projection agreement cannot be treated as evidence for general relativity.
Geometry-like persistence remains projection-derived and non-spacetime.
All GR-like artifacts remain ANALOG_ONLY and NON_PHYSICAL.
